prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the recent price trend: the share price is 10.8% lower than a year ago. Other areas on this side: the quality of the business, the balance sheet.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 7 points in favour and 4 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 44 of 100. The side that carries most weight is growth.
